why: no notes and nothing typed names the mode and offers the folder
typing is a note waiting to happen — the first row writes it
--save typed into the box is searched for, never obeyed — only a row's own exec carries a flag
notes on disk list newest first under the count
setup:
mkdir -p "$HOME/Documents/Notes" && printf '# Standup notes

team sync done
' > "$HOME/Documents/Notes/standup-notes.md" && printf 'plain body
' > "$HOME/Documents/Notes/plain.md" && touch -d @1700000000 "$HOME/Documents/Notes/plain.md" && rm -f "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/oxy-note-saved"
